I have taught more than 200 courses in public and private universities in the U.S., Greece, and Cyprus, teaching in two languages. I have done so in the spirit of Public Sociology, which seeks to engage people from all spheres of society in a multiplicity of ways. International educational programming and Pitt’s new Study Away programs in sociology and in political economy / ecology are my main research and teaching interests now.
